items.title: Jonathan Scales interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 23, 2025
items.q: And there’s a steel band at the school that’s been there since like 1984 started by Dr. Scott Meister.

ctx.x: Was there an AHA! moment that sent you to the pans?

It was more like stumbling upon it. So I went to a school in North Carolina called Appalachian State University. And there’s a steel band at the school that’s been there since like 1984 started by Dr. Scott Meister. And when I got to college as a freshman a lot of my friends were trying to pull me in to trying to be in the steel band. They hold open auditions at the beginning of the semester. And you know you learn a couple tunes, they see how you jive with the band, how you vibe with the band, and then that’s…
Nice. Were you struck by the – I didn’t mean to do a little joke there – when you struck it, did the overtones have an impression, make an impression on you?
